# Subway Seat for Codex CLI

TextMate themes tuned for Codex, whose diff backgrounds come from the theme's added and removed scopes. The status line picks up the same warm syntax colors.

[Codex CLI](https://github.com/openai/codex) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/codex/)

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.codex/config.toml, after copying the theme to ~/.codex/themes/ (or pick it with /theme):

```toml
[tui]
theme = "subway-seat"
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.codex/config.toml, after copying the theme to ~/.codex/themes/ (or pick it with /theme):

```toml
[tui]
theme = "subway-seat-tunnel"
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.codex/config.toml, after copying the theme to ~/.codex/themes/ (or pick it with /theme):

```toml
[tui]
theme = "subway-seat-enamel"
```

**London Moquette**, in ~/.codex/config.toml, after copying the theme to ~/.codex/themes/ (or pick it with /theme):

```toml

theme = "london-moquette"
```

**London Deep Level**, in ~/.codex/config.toml, after copying the theme to ~/.codex/themes/ (or pick it with /theme):


**London Portland**, in ~/.codex/config.toml, after copying the theme to ~/.codex/themes/ (or pick it with /theme):


**Paris Guimard**, in ~/.codex/config.toml, after copying the theme to ~/.codex/themes/ (or pick it with /theme):

**Paris Catacombes**, in ~/.codex/config.toml, after copying the theme to ~/.codex/themes/ (or pick it with /theme):

**Paris Carrelage**, in ~/.codex/config.toml, after copying the theme to ~/.codex/themes/ (or pick it with /theme):


## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.codex/themes/subway-seat.tmTheme`.
- Delete `~/.codex/themes/subway-seat-tunnel.tmTheme`.
- Delete `~/.codex/themes/subway-seat-enamel.tmTheme`.
- Delete `~/.codex/themes/london-moquette.tmTheme`.
- Delete `~/.codex/themes/london-deep-level.tmTheme`.
- Delete `~/.codex/themes/london-portland.tmTheme`.
- Delete `~/.codex/themes/paris-guimard.tmTheme`.
- Delete `~/.codex/themes/paris-catacombes.tmTheme`.
- Delete `~/.codex/themes/paris-carrelage.tmTheme`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
